description: Congressman Juan Ciscomani's campaign has released a new ad titled " Results ," set to air across Arizona's 6th Congressional District. The ad emphasizes Congressman Ciscomani's commitment to effective leadership, bipartisan cooperation, and delivering real results for Arizonans.
title: Congressman Juan Ciscomani Releases New Ad Showcasing Effective Leadership and Bipartisan Results — Juan Ciscomani for Congress
